indicators.label: Census population
indicators.description: Population total in KSH dataflow WBS008 for the county and census wave.
indicators.method: Published KSH county total for settlement type Total.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Twenty KSH county rows joined by NUTS 3 code to GISCO NUTS 3 2021.
indicators.quality_notes: The voluntary religion question has a separate Nem válaszolt (No answer) category.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation among respondents (%)
indicators.description: Share of religion-question respondents in a published named-religion category.
indicators.method: 100 times religious_affiliation_count divided by the sum of religious_affiliation_count and no_religion_count. Katolikus is counted once; its Roman Catholic and Greek Catholic detail rows are not summed twice.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Twenty KSH county rows joined by NUTS 3 code to GISCO NUTS 3 2021.
indicators.quality_notes: The affiliation and no-religion shares are among stated responses. National non-response was 10.8286% in 2001, 27.1578% in 2011, and 40.1154% in 2022. The responding share of the population changed substantially across waves; cross-wave share changes may therefore reflect changing respondent composition as well as changing affiliation. The change metric compares stated-response shares only.

indicators.label: Nem vallásos (%) — No religion among respondents
indicators.description: Share of religion-question respondents in KSH category Nem vallásos.
indicators.method: 100 times no_religion_count divided by the sum of religious_affiliation_count and no_religion_count.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Twenty KSH county rows joined by NUTS 3 code to GISCO NUTS 3 2021.
indicators.quality_notes: Nem vallásos and Nem válaszolt remain separate source categories. The affiliation and no-religion shares are among stated responses. National non-response was 10.8286% in 2001, 27.1578% in 2011, and 40.1154% in 2022. The responding share of the population changed substantially across waves; cross-wave share changes may therefore reflect changing respondent composition as well as changing affiliation. The change metric compares stated-response shares only.

visual_layers.aggregation_rule: sum mutually exclusive named-religion categories; exclude Nem válaszolt from the denominator
visual_layers.notes: The manifest preserves every source category and the Catholic parent/detail relationship. The affiliation and no-religion shares are among stated responses. National non-response was 10.8286% in 2001, 27.1578% in 2011, and 40.1154% in 2022. The responding share of the population changed substantially across waves; cross-wave share changes may therefore reflect changing respondent composition as well as changing affiliation. The change metric compares stated-response shares only.

visual_layers.label: Nem vallásos (%) — No religion among respondents
visual_layers.description: Share of respondents in the published KSH category Nem vallásos.

legend.denominator: respondents to the voluntary religion question

visual_layers.aggregation_rule: Nem vallásos divided by TOTAL minus Nem válaszolt
visual_layers.notes: Nem vallásos and Nem válaszolt remain distinct source categories. The affiliation and no-religion shares are among stated responses.
